event_type.description: The single most consequential thing this filing reports. If several, choose the one a reader would lead with. A dividend or buyback is a capital return, not earnings.

direction.description: For an executive_change, whether the person is arriving or leaving. Null for every other event_type.

summary.description: Two sentences, plain language, naming who did what. No boilerplate, no 'the Company announced that'. The length cap is a backstop, not a target: constrained decoding cuts mid-word at the limit rather than summarising more tightly, so a summary that reaches it has been amputated.

materiality.description: high = likely to move the stock or change the investment case. medium = a reader covering this name should know. low = procedural or administrative.

entities.description: People and organisations named as parties to the event. Not the filer's own lawyers, auditors, or transfer agent.

amounts.description: Monetary figures stated in the filing. Convert to USD. Omit share counts and percentages; leave empty if the filing states no figure.

themes.description: Two to five lowercase topical tags describing the business context, finer-grained than SIC. E.g. 'artificial intelligence', 'regional banking', 'biotech licensing'.

facts_in_exhibit.description: True when the filing's substance is in an attached exhibit rather than the filing body -- e.g. 'the press release is furnished as Exhibit 99.1'.
